package loomtest // import "ubunatic.com/loom/loomtest"

Package loomtest provides a deterministic virtual terminal for testing ANSI
output without a PTY, subprocess, terminal emulator or timing dependency.
It is a stable public package; see docs/APIStability.md.

Feed output to NewVT's io.Writer implementation, then inspect Screen, Cells,
Cursor, CursorVisible, Pen and AltScreen. Coordinates are zero-based; Cells and
FrameCells return independent snapshots. Dimensions are clamped to at least one
cell. A VT is not safe for concurrent use.

Supported output includes UTF-8 text, CR/LF, backspace, tab, cursor positioning,
line/display erasure, SGR attributes and indexed/truecolor, cursor save/restore,
and DEC modes 7 (wrap), 25 (cursor), 1049 (alternate screen) and 2026
(synchronized frames). OSC and DCS payloads are ignored through BEL/ST.
Unsupported sequences are ignored; this is not a complete xterm emulator (scroll
regions, insert/delete operations and terminal queries are unsupported).
Width follows loom/measure's cell policy; pin LOOM_ZWJ=join when testing joined
emoji independently of the caller's terminal configuration.

CONSTANTS

const (
	ColorDefault = vt.ColorDefault
	ColorIndexed = vt.ColorIndexed
	ColorDirect  = vt.ColorDirect
)

FUNCTIONS

func CompareANSI(t testing.TB, reference string, width, height int, render func() string, options ...CompareOptions)
    CompareANSI is the original name for CompareWidget.

    Deprecated: use CompareWidget.

func CompareWidget(t testing.TB, reference string, width, height int, render func() string, options ...CompareOptions)
    CompareWidget calls render and compares its ANSI cells to reference.
    Run the test binary with -update to deliberately rewrite the reference.


TYPES

type Cell = vt.Cell
    Cell represents a single terminal cell containing a rune and its visual
    style.

type Color = vt.Color
    Color represents a terminal foreground or background color: default,
    256-color palette index (0-255), or 24-bit truecolor RGB.

func ColorIndex(n uint8) Color
    ColorIndex returns a 256-color palette entry (0-15 standard/bright ANSI,
    16-255 xterm).

func ColorRGB(r, g, b uint8) Color
    ColorRGB returns a 24-bit truecolor RGB value.

func ColorReset() Color
    ColorReset returns the default terminal color.

type ColorType = vt.ColorType
    ColorType specifies the color encoding mode.

type CompareOptions struct {
	IgnoreColour bool
}
    CompareOptions controls which cell fields CompareWidget checks.

type Style = vt.Style
    Style describes the visual appearance (colors and SGR text attributes) of a
    VT cell.

type VT = vt.VT
    VT is a minimal terminal emulator. It is not safe for concurrent use.

func NewVT(cols, rows int) *VT
    NewVT returns a blank VT of the given size with auto-wrap enabled.
